The Blood of Dawnwalker Vampire Powers Explained

Official overview; values pending

At night Coen can use supernatural vampire abilities shown in official footage, changing both traversal and combat.

Night form

Coen’s vampire side becomes central after dark, creating a deliberate contrast with his human tools during the day.

Shown abilities

Official material shows supernatural traversal and attacks, including wall movement, gravity-like control and claws.
